title: Best Gyms in Auckland 2026 — City-by-City Guide with Prices
meta_desc: Find the best gyms in Auckland with prices, locations, and contract terms compared
intro: Auckland offers a wide range of gym options, with many franchises having multiple locations across the city. With prices starting from $10 per week, there's something for every budget. In this guide, we'll break down the best gyms in Auckland by suburb and price.

sections.heading: Auckland CBD Gyms
sections.body: The Auckland CBD has a high concentration of gyms, with many options available for commuters. Some popular choices include City Fitness, Les Mills, and Jetts Fitness, with prices ranging from $20 to $50 per week.

sections.heading: Commuter Gyms in Auckland
list: Anytime Fitness - multiple locations, including Auckland CBD, Newmarket, and Ponsonby
Jetts Fitness - multiple locations, including Auckland CBD, Takapuna, and Manukau
City Fitness - Auckland CBD and Newmarket locations

sections.heading: North Shore Gyms
sections.body: The North Shore has a range of gym options, with prices starting from $15 per week. Some popular choices include Anytime Fitness, Jetts Fitness, and Snap Fitness, with locations in Takapuna, Devonport, and Glenfield.

sections.heading: South Auckland Gyms
sections.body: South Auckland has a growing number of gym options, with prices starting from $10 per week. Some popular choices include Jetts Fitness, Anytime Fitness, and F45 Training, with locations in Manukau, Papakura, and Pukekohe.
